# build brothel choose province
country_event = {
	id = cosmo_etbrothel_events.201
	title = cosmo_etbrothel_events.201.t
	desc = cosmo_etbrothel_events.201.d
	picture = cosmogfx_PORT_OF_PLEASURE_MENU_1_eventPicture

	is_triggered_only = yes

	trigger = {
		ai = no
		}
		
		immediate = {
			hidden_effect = {				
			random_province = {
				limit = {
							has_province_flag = build_etbrothel_here
						OR = {
							province_has_center_of_trade_of_level = 2	
							is_capital = yes 
						}
						num_free_building_slots = 1 
						NOT = {
							has_building = brothel_district
							ROOT = {
